department: Earth and Planetary Sciences Graduate Program

deadline.value: General deadline January 5, 2027; space available June 1, 2027.

supervisor.value: Applicants must first confirm that a faculty mentor will accept them before applying.

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are for participants in specific preparation programs; the program offers no extra fee fellowships.
fee_waiver.quote: The EPS Graduate Program cannot offer additional Application Fee Fellowships at this time.

funding.value: The page says admitted students need funding secured by the program or advisor, which is not a stated guarantee for all admitted students.
